async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Navigate to the GitLab dashboard from the current project page
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Homepage", exact=True).click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 2: Use the knowledge base function to navigate to milestones dashboard
    await navigate_to_milestones_dashboard(page)
    
    # Step 3: Look for and click the 'New milestone' button
    # Assuming the button is present on the milestones dashboard
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="New milestone", exact=True).click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 4: Fill in the milestone details
    # Fill title
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title").fill("Merge all branches to main")
    # Fill start date (March 15, 2044)
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Start date").fill("2044-03-15")
    # Fill due date (March 30, 2044)
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Due date").fill("2044-03-30")
    
    # Step 5: Submit the form
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Create milestone").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
